usageNotes: Use this to update the human-readable description on an existing QEMU VM snapshot managed by a PDM remote. This is one of the few snapshot operations that is fully synchronous — it returns null immediately with no UPID or task to poll. The caller must hold Resource.Manage on the remote/VM resource path.

examples.summary: Add a description to a pre-upgrade snapshot on a remote VM

params.description: Taken before upgrading Ubuntu 22.04 to 24.04 on 2026-06-29.

tips: This endpoint only updates the description field — snapshot content, RAM state, and disk state cannot be changed after creation.
Omitting the node parameter lets PDM resolve the host automatically; supply it when targeting a specific node in a cluster.
Snapshot names follow the same alphanumeric-plus-dot-dash-underscore pattern as remote IDs — spaces are not allowed.
